note: How plan references (NABRE numbering) land in WEBC for the two books whose WEBC form is the Greek one (docs/PLAN.md D3). Units not named in `segments` map to the same chapter:verse. Every `check` is verified against WEBC text by the pipeline; a failure stops the build. Reviewed via docs/esther-daniel-map.md. Changes need David's approval.

Esth.source: WEBC 43-ESG: Esther translated from the Greek. WEBC merges the six Greek additions into the Hebrew chapters, each enclosed in [square brackets]: A at the start of 1:1, B inside 3:13, C as 4:18-47, D inside 5:1-2, E inside 8:13, F as 10:4-14.

splits.why: WEBC 1:1 holds Addition A (bracketed) followed by the Hebrew 1:1. The plan puts A in esth-01 and chapter 1 in esth-02, so the verse is divided at the closing bracket: 1:1!a = Addition A, 1:1!b = Hebrew 1:1.

segments.why: Addition A (Mordecai's dream; the eunuchs' plot) is the bracketed opening of WEBC 1:1.
Hebrew 1:1 is the unbracketed end of WEBC 1:1.
Hebrew 3:13 is the unbracketed start of WEBC 3:13.
Addition B (the king's decree) is bracketed inside WEBC 3:13. B and Esther 3 are in the same plan section, so the verse is not divided.
Addition C (the prayers of Mordecai and Esther) is WEBC 4:18-47, thirty verses, bracketed.
WEBC 5:1-2 is the Greek expansion of the Hebrew 5:1-2.
Addition D (Esther before the king) is WEBC's expanded 5:1-2. NABRE prints D:1-16 in place of 5:1-2. D and Esther 5 are in the same plan section.
Hebrew 8:13 is the unbracketed text around Addition E in WEBC 8:13.
Addition E (the counter-decree) is bracketed inside WEBC 8:13. E and Esther 8 are in the same plan section.
Addition F (the dream explained; the colophon) is WEBC 10:4-14, eleven verses, bracketed.

Dan.source: WEBC 66-DAG: Daniel with the Greek portions. Chapter 3 uses the Greek numbering (3:1-97, with the Prayer of Azariah and Song of the Three at 3:24-90); chapters 4-6 use English numbering; chapters 13-14 are Susanna and Bel and the Dragon.

segments.why: NABRE ends chapter 3 with three verses that WEBC numbers 4:1-3 (TVTMS record Dan.3:23--4:3, Latin column: Dan.3:100=Last).
NABRE 4:1-34 = WEBC 4:4-37 (TVTMS record Dan.4:4-37: English 4:4-37 = Hebrew/Latin 4:1-34).
NABRE 6:1 = WEBC 5:31 (TVTMS record Dan.5:31--6:28, Hebrew column).
